data.title: Will a $20 Billion Bitcoin Windfall Fuel a Massive MicroStrategy Short Squeeze Oct. 29?
data.description: Strategy reports earnings October 29 after three brutal quarters of multibillion-dollar Bitcoin markdowns, and a massive reversal in fair value accounting could send short sellers scrambling before the week is out.
